_comment: Photos and documents shown on people's pages. `source_dir` holds the originals (kept outside the repo). Run scripts/prepare-media.ps1 to copy/resize them into media/ and cut portraits into images/, then node scripts/build.js. `crop` is [x, y, size] in original pixels for a square portrait. kind: photo | document | album.

items.title: Wheeler family, Christmas 1894, Ireton, Iowa
items.caption: The typed key names, front row: Reppa holding Edna Wheeler, D. A. Wheeler holding Nell Wheeler, Mary Frances, Alonzo holding Elsi (daughter of Roy and Alice), Cora Wheeler Forncrook holding daughter Jessie and son Charlie in front, Vina Wheeler with daughters Florence and Gracie. Second row: Alfred, Judson and Delbert Wheeler, Mable Wheeler Searle, Albert Wheeler (son of Dealton and Vina). Third row: Alice Grinnell Wheeler, Reuben Leroy Wheeler holding son Clarence, Ed Wheeler, George Edwards (Charlotte’s husband) holding son Francis, Charlotte Wheeler holding daughter Hazel, Henry Thomas holding daughter Fannie, Mary Wheeler Thomas, Fred Forncrook, Laura Wheeler, Isaac Wheeler, Dealton Wheeler holding son Elwin. "Children of D.A and Reppa are Edna, Nell, Delbert, Judson, Alfred and Mabel. Melvin not yet born." From the photo pages of Bill Allen’s family document (page 102).
items.source: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by Bill Allen (2011), page 102.

items.title: 1920 census: the McKeldin household at 1143 Carroll Street, Baltimore
items.caption: Charles E. McKeldin (32), a sheet metal worker, his wife Emma (27), their children Lola, Lillian, Helen and Charles (2, "Buckey"), and Emma's parents William H. Bell (66) and Ella Bell (62), listed as father-in-law and mother-in-law. The household is at the bottom of the sheet.
items.source: 1920 United States Federal Census, Baltimore Ward 21, Maryland, ED 364, sheet 4A (NARA T625, roll 666); image from Ancestry.com. Original: National Archives and Records Administration.

items.source: 1900 United States Federal Census, Baltimore Ward 22, Maryland, ED 283, sheet 7 (NARA T623, roll 618); image from Ancestry.com. Original: National Archives and Records Administration.

items.title: 1910 census: the Simons and McPhail households, Delta, Whatcom County, Washington
items.caption: Sheet 4A: John B. McPhail (60) and Ellen R. (59) two households above Aron Simons (58), Hattie (57) and Raymond (12), on Road 18. Sheet 4B, line 51: the Simons household continues with their grandson Zell Busey (4), born in Washington, his father born in Iowa and his mother in Michigan.
items.source: 1910 United States Federal Census, Delta, Whatcom County, Washington, ED 342, sheets 4A–4B (NARA T624, roll 1674); images from Ancestry.com. Original: National Archives and Records Administration.

items.title: WWI draft registration card of Raymond Zell Simons, 26 August 1918
items.caption: Born 14 June 1897 at South Haven, Michigan; living at Blaine, Whatcom County; employed by Will Steen at Milton, Oregon; nearest relative his mother, Mrs. Hattie Simons, RFD 2, Blaine. Father's birthplace Indiana. Tall, medium build, blue eyes, dark brown hair. Registered by Ernest O. Draper.
items.source: U.S., World War I Selective Service System Draft Registration Cards, 1917–1918, Whatcom County, Washington (NARA M1509); image from Ancestry.com. Original: National Archives and Records Administration.
